title: FleetForge v2.7.1 Enterprise IT Edition
changelog: Official Release v2.7.1 Enterprise IT Edition with Multi-Language Platform & Quality Assurance certification
Multi-Language Platform: Live dynamic UI language translation across 16 global languages without application restart
Automatic Windows OS system language detection on launch (Culture/UI Culture ISO code)
Header Language Selector dropdown menu next to Help with crisp embedded high-resolution country flag icons
Direct 16-language selection list showing active language pre-checked with visual indicator
Localized Quick Setup packs, catalog search badges, buttons, chips, status pills, and counter texts
Unified inline search with automatic Winget cloud package loading appended seamlessly in catalog
Automatic Display Resolution & UI Scaling Engine (Auto, 100%, 90%, 80%)
User Display Zoom Settings with responsive presets for 720p, 768p, 1080p, and 4K displays
